claims: Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the 98th Academy Awards (2026)
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons
Amy Madigan set a record for the longest gap (40 years) between nominations
The field that Amy Madigan defeated included Elle Fanning and Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas (Sentimental Value)
The field that Amy Madigan defeated included Wunmi Mosaku (Sinners)
The field that Amy Madigan defeated included Teyana Taylor (One Battle After Another)
